1934, April
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 186 Cont.
Apr. 10 Covn. Frear - 49 - Mental. Flavia Canemeo - 35 - T.B.
Hazen Allen - 31 - stroke, speech gone quite - otherwise improving since prayed for and Feb. 23 enrolled.
Page 187
Apr. 15 Mary Padden - 63 - stroke - quite ailing.
Al. Mink - 51 - pneumonia
15 Chester Kozelsky - 21 - 34 days unconscious - from Feb. 2nd to March 6th - Enrolled about Feb. 15 Here To-day O.K. .. . . .
16 Wm. M. Walker - 65 - cancer of rectum Leonard Moeller - 57 - heart trouble
16 Sister Olimpi. ... Felician Headquarters - cannot obey ..... poverty · ....
Mrs. A, Kinner- Dr. K's wife - throat cancer.
August Toporiski - 27 - out of work 5 yrs. - till 6 week ago. Now rhumatic fears will not be able ..... once a year to Commu'n. Enrol- led this a.m.
Anne Koore - 47 - threatened cancer - oper'n.
Kathleen
Mrs. Dresden - 44 - Thank God threatening lump has vanished from breast.
Eunice Lavniley - 19 - mentally hopeless - Jas. Miller - 23 - nervous
Page 188 April Mrs. Mary Riesterer - 51 - fears groth on breast. Enrolls Poor Souls To-day 20 times (10.00)
Mrs. Berry - 62 - non Cath. - 2nd stroke last Thursday.
